title: FY2024 NDAA artificial-intelligence assurance and security provisions
last_action: Enacted as part of the National Defense Authorization Act for Fiscal Year 2024.
summary: A curated group of FY2024 NDAA provisions establishing AI bug-bounty work, generative-AI detection and watermarking efforts, responsible-AI processes, a study of privacy, security, accuracy, explainability, and emergent behavior in military AI, and intelligence-community guidance for AI-assisted analysis.
committee_dynamics: The provisions moved through the annual defense-authorization vehicle rather than as a standalone AI statute. The prior tracker citation to sections 220–225 was corrected because those sections address unrelated defense research and acquisition matters.
advance_rationale: Enacted law; implementation replaces advancement forecasting.

responsible_agencies: Office of the Director of National Intelligence

deadlines.requirement: Complete the responsible-AI strategy and process requirements due 120 days after enactment.
Complete the military AI functionality, research-needs, privacy, security, and accuracy study due one year after enactment.

agency_status.detail: The statutory requirements are captured; a comprehensive official implementation assessment has not yet been completed for this grouped record.

verification_level: Official public-law text and section citations verified; implementation status requires a dedicated agency review.

sources.title: Public Law 118-31 — FY2024 National Defense Authorization Act

claim_provenance.note: Section grouping and summary are analyst-created from the enacted text.
